About Doyen Website Developer

Doyen Website Developer is a website development and digital presence service focused on helping startups and small businesses build modern, fast, mobile-friendly and SEO-ready websites. It serves businesses in Jamshedpur and Bangalore and can work with clients beyond these locations.

Whether you need a first website, a redesign of a slow or dated one, or a store to sell online, the work starts with your business: what you sell, who buys it and what you want visitors to do. Read more about Doyen and how projects work.

Why Doyen

  • Business-first thinking

    Every decision starts from what your business needs the website to do.

  • Custom design

    Layouts are designed for your brand and content, not dropped into a generic template.

  • Mobile-first development

    Sites are designed and checked at phone width first, because that is where many visitors arrive.

  • Performance

    Lean code, optimised images and minimal scripts keep pages quick to load and respond.

  • SEO foundations

    Structure, metadata, sitemaps and structured data are built in, without promises about rankings.

  • Conversion-focused UX

    Each page has a clear next step, presented without pressure.

  • Clear communication

    Plain language, agreed scope and regular check-ins, with no jargon for its own sake.

  • Personalised approach

    You work directly with the person building your site.

How projects work

  1. Discover

    We talk through your business, your customers and your goals, and look at what you already have, including any existing website.

  2. Plan

    We agree the pages, features, content and timeline, and confirm scope and quote before design begins.

  3. Design

    Layouts and visual direction are shaped around your brand and reviewed with you, starting at phone width.

  4. Develop

    The approved design is built with clean, accessible code, optimised images and the SEO foundations in place.

  5. Launch

    The site is tested across devices, deployed, and connected to analytics and Search Console.

  6. Improve

    After launch we review how the site is performing and recommend sensible next improvements.

Frequently asked questions

What does a website developer do?

A website developer builds and maintains websites that help businesses present their products, services and information online. This includes planning the structure, designing how pages look and behave, writing the code, making the site fast and mobile-friendly, and launching it. Doyen Website Developer also covers UI/UX design, SEO foundations, branding and social media content for startups and small businesses.

How much does a business website cost?

The cost depends on the scope of the project, so Doyen provides a custom quote rather than a fixed price list. The main factors are the number of pages, how much custom design is needed, features such as e-commerce or booking, and whether content or branding support is needed. Send a short description through the contact page to get a quote.

How long does website development take?

The timeline depends on the size of the project and how quickly content and feedback are provided. A focused landing page generally takes less time than a multi-page business website or an online store. A realistic timeline is agreed in the planning stage, before the work starts.

Do you build websites for small businesses?

Yes, small businesses and startups are the main focus of Doyen Website Developer. That includes local businesses, professional services, D2C brands and creators. The website is scaled to what the business needs now and structured so it can grow.

Do you build e-commerce websites?

Yes, Doyen builds e-commerce websites, from small catalogues to growing online stores. The platform is chosen to suit your products, budget and the person who will manage the store. The focus is on clear product pages, a simple checkout and a fast mobile experience.

Can you redesign an existing website?

Yes, an existing website can be redesigned or rebuilt. The first step is a review of what works and what does not, such as speed, mobile layout, clarity and search visibility. Then we decide whether a refresh or a full rebuild makes more sense.

Will my website be mobile-friendly?

Yes, every website is designed and tested mobile-first. Layouts are built at phone width first and then expanded for larger screens, with readable text and comfortable tap targets, because many visitors will arrive on a phone.

Will my website be SEO-ready?

Yes, websites are built with technical SEO foundations, although no one can guarantee search rankings. That means clean structure, unique titles and descriptions, a sitemap, structured data and fast pages. Rankings also depend on content quality, competition and time.

Do you provide website maintenance?

Ongoing support and improvements can be arranged after launch. What this covers, such as updates, content changes or performance reviews, is discussed and agreed per project so that it matches what your site needs.

Do you work with businesses outside Jamshedpur?

Yes, Doyen is based in Jamshedpur and Bangalore and works with clients elsewhere too. Projects are run through calls, messages and shared files, so location is rarely a barrier.

Do you work with businesses outside Bangalore?

Yes, clients do not need to be in Bangalore. Doyen works with businesses across India and beyond. Meetings happen online, and in person where it is practical in Jamshedpur or Bangalore.

How do I start a project?

Start by sending a short description of your business and what you need through the contact form. Share your name, business, the service you need and a rough budget range. Doyen replies to discuss your goals and, if it is a fit, provides a custom quote.
